_comment: Copy this file to the root of your vault as kb.config.json and edit it. All paths are relative to the vault root. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored.
_exempt_dirs: Folders whose notes are not checked for schema, orphans or outgoing links, and are left out of the index. A single folder name (node_modules/) matches at any depth; a longer path (docs/vendor/) matches from the vault root. Put third-party documentation and code here before looking at any number.
_orphan_ok_types: Notes of these types are not reported as orphans (leaf notes such as sources, emails, meeting minutes that nothing needs to link to).
_orphans_scope: Paths checked for orphans. Empty = the folders in required_paths if there are any, otherwise the whole vault. Use ["*"] to check everything even when required_paths is set. Links from notes outside the scope still count.
_secret_scan_extensions: File types the secret scan reads. By default notes, scripts and JSON (the list shown here): a real secret is more likely to sit in a script or a settings file than in a note. Narrow the list to scan less (for example [".md"]). .env also covers .env.local and similar. The summary line of kb_lint says how many files of each type were read. Matches inside fenced code blocks of Markdown notes are reported separately as secret-in-example (warning).
_secret_file_patterns: Key files recognized by their extension (or a .local_secrets folder) are reported as secret-file (path only, content not read), hidden folders included. Code, documentation and public-key files are never reported because of their name. All secret checks skip exempt_dirs, secret_scan_exclude and dependency folders (site-packages, node_modules, vendor, venv). An encryption key stored next to the data it protects protects nothing.
_secret_scan_exclude: Path -> reason. Same matching as exempt_dirs; a reason is mandatory. An exclusion can expire: write {"path/": {"reason": "public sign-up token, no permissions", "until": "YYYY-MM-DD"}} (or a list of {"path", "reason", "until"} objects). The last day is included; after it the exclusion no longer applies, the findings come back as errors that say "exclusion expired", and kb_lint warns about the entry.
_capture_dirs: Folders of logs, exports and archives (same matching as exempt_dirs, for example ["exports/", "logs/"]). A secret-looking string there is reported as secret-in-capture (warning) instead of an error, because it is captured data nobody wrote as a note; a private-key block stays an error. Large JSON files (over 1 MB, or lines over 5,000 characters) are treated the same way without being listed.
_index_scope: Which notes the index lists: valid (default; only notes whose frontmatter passes the schema), required (only notes under required_paths) or all (every note with a frontmatter). Notes left out are counted on the index page; kb_lint --schema lists them.
